shortDescription: Manage an enrolled Hyperledger Fabric identity

options.name: api_authtype
options.description: C(basic) - Authenticate to the Fabric operations console using basic authentication. You must provide both a valid API key using I(api_key) and API secret using I(api_secret).

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The URL for the Fabric operations console.

options.name: api_key
options.description: The API key for the Fabric operations console.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: The API secret for the Fabric operations console. Only required when I(api_authtype) is C(basic).

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: The timeout, in seconds, to use when interacting with the Fabric operations console.

options.name: certificate_authority
options.description: The certificate authority to use to enroll this identity. You can pass a string, which is the display name of a certificate authority registered with the Fabric operations console. You can also pass a dictionary, which must match the result format of one of the M(certificate_authority_info) or M(certificate_authority) modules. Only required when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: enrollment_id
options.description: The enrollment ID, or user name, of an identity registered on the certificate authority for this peer. Only required when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: enrollment_secret
options.description: The enrollment secret, or password, of an identity registered on the certificate authority for this peer. Only required when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: force_reenroll
options.description: True if the identity should be re-enrolled, false otherwise. If specified, then the identity will be re-enrolled every time that your playbook is run.

options.name: hosts
options.description: The list of host names to add to the certificate as X.509 Subject Alternative Names. Can only be specified when enrolling the identity against the TLS certificate authority.

options.name: hsm
options.description: The PKCS #11 compliant HSM configuration to use for generating and storing the private key.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the enrolled identity. Only required when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: path
options.description: The path to the JSON file where the enrolled identity will be stored.

options.name: reenroll_before_expiry
options.description: Use this option to automatically re-enroll the identity before the certificate expires. Specified as the maximum time in seconds before the expiration of the certificate. For example, to automatically re-enroll the identity when there are less than 30 days remaining before the certificate expires, set this option to C(2592000).

options.name: state
options.description: C(absent) - A certificate authority matching the specified name will be stopped and removed. C(present) - Asserts that a certificate authority matching the specified name and configuration exists. If no certificate authority matches the specified name, a certificate authority will be created. If a certificate authority matches the specified name but the configuration does not match, then the certificate authority will be updated, if it can be.
